record.question: Mary is expecting a baby _________ six weeks.
record.explanation: Answer D: in. In six weeks means after a six-week period (D). Independent check: “In six weeks” means six weeks from now, the expected time until the birth. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/in-at-on. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
